scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm --workspace apps/api run build && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run prisma:generate && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.build:api:exe: npm --workspace apps/api run build && set PKG_CACHE_PATH=.pkg-cache&& npm.cmd exec pkg -- apps/api/dist/main.js --targets node22-win-x64 --public --public-packages "*" --no-bytecode --output apps/desktop/src-tauri/binaries/residual-ink-api-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe
scripts.desktop:prepare: node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && npm run build:api:exe && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:prepare && tauri dev --config apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:prepare && tauri build --config apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
